title: Kate and the Acorn with a Long Plan
synopsis: Kate the hedgehog finds an acorn and discovers how a little seed, a small sapling, and an old oak belong to the same long story.

related_resources.reason: An oak begins as an acorn and can develop from a seedling into a sapling and mature tree over time.
An optional question can connect the seed and adult tree, without requiring the child to predict exact growth rates.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: “That oak was little once too,” the gardener said. “It began with an acorn.”

rationale_citations.evidence_scope: The science source supports only the natural or physical phenomenon mentioned in the anchor. The characters, plots and observed details of the invented scene are fiction; no impact on sleep, curiosity or learning is established.
